title: Extraction Prepare Manifest
description: Schema for the stage 1 manifest written by extraction_prepare.py. Tracks progress, fingerprint, and issues for the mechanical skeleton-building step of Data Extraction.

status.description: in_progress while batches are being written; complete when all skeletons have been written.

packets_read.description: Number of valid Source Packets successfully read from the input directory.

snippets_found.description: Total snippet entries found across all valid packets (including any that had issues).

total_skeletons.description: Number of Extraction Record skeletons to be written across all batches.

skeletons_written.description: Number of skeletons written so far.

batches_written.description: Number of batch directories written so far.

batch_size.description: Maximum number of skeletons per batch directory.

last_batch_written.description: Batch number of the last batch written. 0 if no batch has been written yet. Used to resume interrupted runs.

issues.description: Issues encountered during stage 1. Each entry names the affected packet or snippet and the issue type.

input_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the input packet directory (names + sizes). If the fingerprint changes between runs, the script refuses to continue to prevent mixing outputs from different inputs.

started_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when stage 1 first started.

completed_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when stage 1 completed successfully. Null while in progress.

packet_id.description: packet_id of the affected packet, or null if the issue is not packet-specific.

snippet_id.description: snippet_id of the affected snippet, if the issue is snippet-level.

issue_type.description: Closed enum of issue types registered by stage 1.

detail.description: Human-readable detail about the specific issue.
